fact: Seychelles took part in the 24th COMESA Summit in Nairobi, 7 to 9 October 2025, themed on leveraging digitalisation for regional value chains.
title: Seychelles participates in the 24th Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA) Summit in Nairobi, Kenya
